subject.title: Dashboard: inter-widget pub/sub — a tab-scoped message bus

question: Should OpenClaw pursue inter-widget pub/sub as part of the bundled modular dashboard direction after Wave 1, or keep widget-to-widget composition outside core until the dashboard stack is accepted?
rationale: The issue adds a new user-facing dashboard app capability and a cross-widget security boundary on top of open, unmerged dashboard PRs; automation cannot choose that product/security boundary from source inspection alone.

options.title: Defer behind Wave 1 acceptance
options.body: Keep this issue open but do not queue a new PR until the linked dashboard substrate, Workspaces UI, and custom-widget bridge direction is accepted or narrowed.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow typed bus
options.body: Ask for a focused follow-up that adds tab-local topic routing, sender/subscription lifecycle rules, payload typing, regression tests, and browser proof.

options.title: Route to external experiment
options.body: Ask contributors to prove the widget-composition model as an external plugin or ClawHub package before considering bundled OpenClaw promotion.

recommendation.title: Defer behind Wave 1 acceptance
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open but do not queue a new PR until the linked dashboard substrate, Workspaces UI, and custom-widget bridge direction is accepted or narrowed.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent current-main ownership signal for the Control UI plugin-tab seam and the product/security boundary this feature would extend.
